layout_and_spacing.container: Generous spacing. Main chat/content area uses p-6 md:p-12.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for switching between the 6 agents. Standard SaaSFame pattern. Width: 280px or collapsed to icon-only.
layout_and_spacing.chat_bento: Use bento grid layout for dashboard overview (Agent Selection Mode), or a full height flex layout for Active Agent Chats.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness. rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-[2rem] for chat bubbles (with asymmetrical border-radius for speech tail effect).
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers or floating navs. 1px solid border-white/40.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A3629] text-white hover:bg-[#264D3A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F1EFEA] text-[#1A1D1C] hover:bg-[#E8E5DD] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#C16252] text-white hover:bg-[#A85344] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300

inputs.default: Shadcn UI Input/Textarea heavily customized: bg-white border-[#E8E5DD] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A3629]/20 focus:border-[#1A3629] transition-all

chat_bubbles.bot: bg-[#F1EFEA] text-[#1A1D1C] rounded-3xl rounded-tl-sm p-6 shadow-sm border border-[#E8E5DD]/50
chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#1A3629] text-white rounded-3xl rounded-tr-sm p-6 shadow-md

forms.structure: For Job Application, Feedback, and Appointment agents: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Calendar. Go cardless or use very subtle flat white cards with 1px border. Generous spacing (gap-6) between fields.

animations.hover: Smooth transform translations (-translate-y-1) for agent selection cards. transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
animations.chat_entrance: Staggered fade-up for messages using framer-motion. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}.
animations.interactions: Micro-interactions on buttons (scale down 0.98 on active).

assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for duotone, friendly organic icons.

healthcare_hero_bg.description: Abstract warm earthy tones background for empty states or login screens.

agent_avatar_female.description: Friendly female agent avatar (Healthcare, Customer Support).

agent_avatar_male.description: Empathetic male agent avatar (Job Applications, Medical Appointments).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #1A3629 and #1A1D1C text on #F1EFEA pass WCAG AA/APCA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='agent-select-healthcare').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion lucide-react
Add fonts: Load Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Configure Tailwind: Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors, fonts, and borderRadius extensions.
Layout Architecture: Create a main Dashboard layout with a left sidebar (Navigation for the 6 agents) and a main content area. Implement a top header using the 'glassmorphism' rules.

Agent Hub: Create a landing view within the dashboard (Bento grid) showcasing all 6 available agents: 1. Healthcare AI, 2. Job Application Agent, 3. Customer Support, 4. Client Feedback, 5. Appointment Request, 6. Customer Service.
Chat Interface: Implement a unified chat interface. Each agent should have its own context, but share the same beautiful UI. Use the chat_bubbles styling provided.

Forms UI: For Job Application, Medical Appointments, and Feedback, intersperse the chat UI with rich, interactive Shadcn forms (e.g., bot asks 'Please fill out your details', rendering a beautiful inline form card).
Use the provided avatars for the bots depending on the persona (e.g., agent_avatar_female for Healthcare, agent_avatar_male for Appointments).
Maintain the generous spacing (p-6 to p-12) and organic feel. Avoid harsh lines, deep black (#000000), or pure blue/red. Use the semantic colors strictly.
